class.name: SteamPartyBeacon
class.brief_description: An owned Steam Party publication scoped to its active Game lobby.

method.name: change_open_slots
method.description: Requests a new count of zero to 64 unreserved seats. The count cannot exceed current authority capacity after outstanding reservations. Await the operation to observe Steam's response.

method.name: complete
method.description: Acknowledges the exact reserved account after the authority confirms that it reached the current world. The Game also performs this acknowledgment automatically.

method.name: cancel
method.description: Returns the exact pending reservation to Steam. A guest already in flight still follows the ordinary Game admission rules.

method.name: close
method.description: Withdraws the exact beacon and retires its reservations and local slot observer.

members.member: Opaque decimal identifier of this publication. The identifier remains readable after closure.

signal.name: reservation_received
signal.description: Emitted for an exact Steam reservation on this live beacon. The authority returns abandoned seats after its deadline.

signal.name: closed
signal.description: Emitted after the beacon is retired and local reservation state is cleared.
